mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_registration (user_id, activity_id, check_in_status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{checkInStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, activity_id, check_in_status, create_time, update_time FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, activity_id, check_in_status, create_time, update_time FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_registration SET check_in_status = #{checkInStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND check_in_status = 'NOT_CHECKED_IN'
UPDATE activity_registration SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
